question: What consequence follows when a site has its own flaw or is deficient by a quarter?
premises: A site may have an inherent flaw.
A site may be deficient by a quarter.
Such a condition leads to a harmful outcome.
inference: A site that has its own flaw or is deficient by a quarter is destroyed.
plain_english: If it has its own flaw or is deficient by a quarter, that site is destroyed.
